citations.claim: Muay Thai is an officially recognised soft power activity qualifying for the DTV
citations.source: Muay Thai Visa Thailand — Soft Power and the DTV
citations.evidence: Page states verbatim: "Muay Thai is a top-tier Soft Power activity".

citations.claim: DTV application fee is 10,000 THB; proof of funds is 500,000 THB on a 3-month bank statement; apply from outside Thailand
citations.evidence: Page states: "The application fee is 10,000 baht" and "bank statements covering the last three months showing at least 500,000 baht"; "You cannot apply from inside Thailand".

citations.claim: thaievisa.go.th is the official Thailand electronic visa portal (only DTV application system since Jan 2025)
citations.evidence: Portal self-identifies in its title as "Official Website of Thailand Electronic Visa"; corroborated by The Thaiger.

unverified.claim: Six-month training program is favored by immigration
unverified.reason: Observed approval practice through 2025-2026, NOT a published legal rule. No official/legal source asserts it as a rule (MTVT does not frame it as legal). Kept as 'observed practice', no link, consistent with docs/dtv-fact-check.md #16.

unverified.claim: Gym DTV papers range 7,500–25,000 THB for the same documents
unverified.reason: Community-reported (Reddit, docs/reddit-insights). Not attributable to a single authoritative source by design (never cite a Reddit pseudonym). Reformulated as community-reported range, no link.
